sources.snippet: This repository contains a Jupyter/Colab notebook that demonstrates how to fine‑tune BERT for sentiment analysis on the IMDb movie reviews dataset. The notebook walks through: Loading and preprocessing the IMDb dataset Tokenizing text with Hugging Face transformers Fine‑tuning BERT for binary classification (positive vs negative reviews) Evaluating the model's performance
